$comment.description:
This document outlines the specifications for the RTR ISO 20022 System Event Acknowledgement (Heartbeat Acknowledgement) message. Prior to reading this RTR ISO 20022 Message Specification, it is highly recommended to read the RTR ISO 20022 Message Specification Companion Document that is published alongside it since the Companion provides high-level context and an overview of the message portfolio and content. 

RTR Usage:
This message will be sent by the RTR Participants to RTR as a receipt acknowledgment of the heartbeat notification admi.004 message. 

Scope:
The SystemEventAcknowledgement message is sent by a participant of a central system to the central system to acknowledge the notification of an occurrence of an event in a central system.
